rationale: The candidate correctly identifies the controlling program-specific variable as `<PROGRAM>_ACTIVE_HELP`, supported by `active_help.go:45-57` and its construction in `active_help.go:59-67`. It also correctly states that `COBRA_ACTIVE_HELP=0` globally disables Active Help, supported by `active_help.go:49-50` and the constants at `active_help.go:24-31`. The description of `<PROGRAM>` is substantively supported, though the bundle more precisely says the uppercase root-command name with non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters replaced by `_`.
